30455bff1c9b: How much does travel agency management software cost with Travelife?
996cf03038a7: Travelife costs between 199 € and 599 € per month depending on the plan you choose, plus a one-time setup fee. The ERP Core plan is 199 € per month for 5 users (1,500 € setup), ERP Business is 399 € per month for 10 users (3,000 € setup) and ERP Connect is 599 € per month for 20 users (4,000 € setup). It is a fixed SaaS subscription with no commission on your sales, including technical support, initial training and automatic updates.
514ce458863e: Which Travelife plan should I choose for my travel agency?
04c4f50faae4: It all depends on your business. ERP Core suits agencies that want to manage quotes, orders, customer and supplier invoicing, cash, margins, CRM and VAT on margin, without APIs or a booking engine. ERP Business adds the admin console to build your own offers: packages, hotel contracts, internal catalog, allotments, transport and rooming lists. ERP Connect adds the internal booking engine, 2 included APIs, NDC / GDS management and multi-supplier connectivity, for agencies selling flights and accommodation in real time.

The program is open to tourism businesses in Morocco, including travel agencies. 4a0aebac9281: Does Travelife travel agency software require installation?
5bbee64290f7: No. Travelife is 100% cloud software delivered as SaaS: no installation or server is required at your agency. The setup fee covers the deployment of your cloud environment, continuous monitoring and security protocols. New features and security patches are then deployed automatically with no downtime, and your teams access the platform from a simple web browser. More than 200 travel agencies already use Travelife every day.
661bc3c3b318: What is the difference between Travelife ERP pricing and B2C website pricing?
d7b4ddc43c39: Travelife ERP pricing covers the agency's internal management software: quotes, invoicing, cash, margins, CRM, production and supplier connectivity. B2C website pricing covers building the booking website for your end customers, with CMS, hotel, tour and package modules and online payment. Website plans start at 99 € per month (Starter) and 399 € per month (Advanced), with the Premium / Enterprise plan available on quote. Full details are available on the travel agency website pricing page.
